hold_reason: Discrepancy between Alpha Co's handoff and the refunds ledger. W2 reported refund order_id 214 (amount_cents 6668) as applied, but list_refunds returns only order_ids 211 (12701) and 213 (15133). The voucher confirms only that Alpha sent the report, not that refunds were applied. Paying from net_balance could overpay the customer tied to order 214. No payouts have been recorded. Needs confirmation that refund 214 was applied, or correction of the handoff, before payouts resume.
